facts.business: Bohra Industries Limited had no significant transactions, nil turnover, and no major operational activity during the financial year ended 31st March 2026.

auditor.name: M/s Valawat & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: The Company does not have any significant transactions during the year. The turnover of the Company is NIL and there is no major operational activity during the year. However, the management is hopeful to meet the Company's obligation and continuing business operations. Having regards to this, financial statements have been prepared on the basis of going concern. Hence no adjustments have been made to the carrying value of Assets and Liabilities of the Company. Our Opinion is not Qualified in this matter.

key_risks: Company has nil turnover and no major operational activity, raising going concern uncertainty
Delays in regulatory filings under SEBI LODR Regulations (Regulation 31(1)(b), 17(1), 74(5))
Gaps/delays in compliance with SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 relating to Structured Digital Database maintenance
Temporary gap in optimum composition of Board of Directors due to vacancy in Independent Director position
